newsitem.title: CHINA: Ericsson launches China assembly line.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson launches China assembly line.

text.p: Swedish telecommunications group Ericsson has launched a $4.0 million cellular telephone assembly line in China, the Xinhua news agency said on Friday.
The new line, launched on Thursday in Beijing by joint venture Beijing Ericsson Mobile Telecom Co, had a production capacity of 300,000 units a year, Xinhua said.
Beijing Ericsson sold 260,000 mobile telephones on the Chinese market last year and notched up 1.4 billion yuan ($168 million) in sales, the agency said.
Ericsson would set up a research and development institute in China this year, it said, but gave no further details.
